comments.author: PixelWarrior
comments.content: The parry sound effect and visual sparks give such a crunchy game feel. Highly recommended for fans of precise action RPGs.

comments.author: SynthRacer
comments.content: Completed a zero-damage run on the demo boss! The slide jump momentum is pure perfection. Can't wait for 2027 release.

comments.author: HorrorAficionado
comments.content: Atmosphere is 10/10, but mouse sensitivity setting resets to default every time you enter a new room. Actionable bug report submitted.
